go.zova_object_id_from_bytes: ObjectIDFor computes the same SHA-256 identity in Go with crypto/sha256, without a cgo call
go.zova_object_chunk_id_from_bytes: ObjectChunkIDFor computes the same SHA-256 identity in Go with crypto/sha256, without a cgo call

wasm.zova_database_backup: browsers use zova_database_backup_with_progress, which reports progress and can be cancelled
wasm.zova_database_compact: browsers use zova_database_compact_with_progress, which reports progress and can be cancelled
wasm.zova_database_restore: restoreBackup opens the stored source and copies it with zova_database_backup_with_progress; restoreBackupToMemory uses zova_database_restore_to_memory
wasm.zova_database_migrate: migratePersistent stages and publishes through zova_database_migrate_with_progress
wasm.zova_database_migrate_with_extensions: extension bundles are files loaded at run time, which browsers cannot do; linked plugins use the _with_plugins calls
wasm.zova_database_open_with_extensions: extension bundles are files loaded at run time, which browsers cannot do; linked plugins use the _with_plugins calls
wasm.zova_database_create_with_extensions: extension bundles are files loaded at run time, which browsers cannot do; linked plugins use the _with_plugins calls
wasm.zova_extension_bundle_verify: browsers cannot load extension bundles, so there is no bundle to verify
wasm.zova_extension_bundle_trust: browsers cannot load extension bundles, so there is no trust store
wasm.zova_extension_bundle_untrust: browsers cannot load extension bundles, so there is no trust store
wasm.zova_vector_put: putVector goes through zova_vector_put_many with one item
wasm.zova_graph_node_put: putGraphNode goes through zova_graph_node_put_many with one item
wasm.zova_graph_edge_put: putGraphEdge goes through zova_graph_edge_put_many with one item
wasm.zova_graph_walk: graphWalk goes through zova_graph_walk_direction, which takes the default outgoing direction
wasm.zova_database_set_journal_mode: the browser runtime keeps every writable database in DELETE journal mode with one connection per persistent name, so there is no WAL to select or checkpoint
wasm.zova_database_journal_modes: the browser runtime keeps every writable database in DELETE journal mode with one connection per persistent name, so there is no WAL to select or checkpoint
wasm.zova_database_checkpoint: the browser runtime keeps every writable database in DELETE journal mode with one connection per persistent name, so there is no WAL to select or checkpoint
wasm.zova_database_set_commit_protocol: the experimental cross-file commit protocol (CWAL) needs WAL mode and POSIX file locks, and the browser build does not compile it
